content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I am planning an application using a [product_name] module, mainly for its straightforward installation. This setup includes combining it with a [product_name] HMI panel. A key requirement is data logging for parameters such as temperature and pressure. Additionally, I want to save log files from the HMI to a network drive on a local PC. If I purchase the starter package for the Comfort panel, will I be able to achieve this functionality without extra software?

Hi, When you get the starter package for the Comfort panel, it can connect to the [product_name] module. Comfort panels also support data logging. You might have already seen this resource: how do you set up a connection between the [product_name] module and an HMI panel? Best regards,

Thanks for the quick response! That is the guide I was looking at. So, with the [product_name] HMI software included in the starter package, can I access logged data from a network-connected external PC?
Hello, You can log data either on a memory card in the HMI panel or to a folder on a PC connected via Ethernet. This related forum thread might be useful: [url] Best regards,
Thank you, that's exactly what I needed! Regards,

I've reviewed the material you mentioned. It discusses a Basic panel that shares a folder with an external PC. Is this solution applicable for data logging, or is this feature exclusive to Comfort panels? Thanks!

Hello, That guide explains how to connect a panel to an Ethernet network. Data logging isn't supported on the Basic Panel; you'll need a Comfort panel for that purpose. For differences between various [product_name] panels, see this link: [url] Best regards,

analysis.insight_summary: Users are discussing the use of [product_name] modules together with Comfort and Basic HMI panels, mainly concerning data logging features and network connectivity. There is interest in saving log files directly to a PC over a network and clarification of software requirements. The conversation clarifies that only Comfort panels support this kind of data logging, while Basic panels do not have this capability.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects the Comfort panel starter package to allow data logging to a network drive without additional software purchases. They also want to know if Basic panels provide similar logging functions.
